ott.remote_find.description: Native remote-control Settings action. Reads the explicitly configured public discovery catalog; does not approve pairing.

ott.remote_unconfigured.description: Hint on manual Remote control server entry when no discovery catalog is configured. Manual entry remains available.

ott.remote_invalid_profile.description: Hint on manual Remote control server entry when the build discovery profile is invalid. Manual entry remains available.

ott.remote_finding.description: Native discovery progress, shown in the Find row and status.

ott.remote_choose.description: Native discovery result prompt. The viewer must choose a visible server before pairing.

ott.remote_empty.description: Native discovery found no servers. The same Find action retries; manual address entry remains available.

ott.remote_failed.description: Native discovery failed. The same Find action retries; manual address entry remains available.

ott.remote_choice_expired.description: A previously displayed discovery choice is no longer current. Find again instead of guessing another server.
